title: STILL-PRESENT: warn 65s PNG scope line names only the mojibake — the capture's element re-name (bundle 3→1) + outline move stay unattributed
evidence:
spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:176-178 (verbatim): '  is byte-identical: the demo commands never moved), warn T1 (300 shifted hashes at ticks 1201-1500 —

Pixel diff of git show f906725:goldens/warn/65000ms.png vs 121d8a0: 4316 differing px in TWO bands — the title line (y10-24) AND the crisis-outline band (y354-533, x490-933). detail: The re-bless attributes the 65s PNG change solely to the mojibake dash; the same commit's capture also re-named the bundle digit (3→1) and moved the red outline — a verifier reading the scope line is misled about what moved.
recommended_fix: Extend the parenthetical: 'the 65s PNG (the mojibake + the margin-fix element re-name, bundle 3→1)', mirroring the qos attribution 'the banner now names bundle 0'.
